AboutTEDx.title: About
AboutTEDx.description: In the spirit of discovering and spreading ideas, TED has created a program called TEDx. TEDx is a program of local, self-organized events that bring people together to share a TED-like experience. Our event is called TEDxDamascus where x = independently organized TED event. At our TEDxDamascus event, TED Talks video and live speakers will combine to spark deep discussion and connection in a small group. The TED Conference provides general guidance for the TEDx program, but individual TEDx events, including ours, are self-organized.

AddYourLine.question: What idea rising from Damascus should reach the world

AnswersPage.weeklyDescription: Every week, we explore the intersection of ancient wisdom and modern innovation. Share your perspective and join the conversation.
AnswersPage.mockAnswer1: The modular nature of Damascene wood inlay (Mosaic) is essentially early low-poly design — geometry repeated at human scale. Each piece locks into the next the way ideas lock into a community when they are shared carefully.
AnswersPage.mockAnswer2: Culture is not something we inherit — it is something we actively shape every day.
AnswersPage.mockAnswer3: Hope travels fastest when it is carried by many voices at once.
AnswersPage.mockAnswer4: Education that meets people where they are can unlock futures no wall could predict.
AnswersPage.mockAnswer5: Art in public space reminds a city that it still belongs to everyone who walks through it.
AnswersPage.mockAnswer6: Listening without rushing to fix is a radical act of respect.
AnswersPage.mockAnswer7: Small consistent actions compound into movements larger than any single headline.
AnswersPage.mockAnswer8: Technology is only as human as the empathy we bake into its first line of code.
AnswersPage.mockAnswer9: The best ideas survive not because they are loud, but because they are useful.
AnswersPage.mockAnswer10: Community safety starts with trust built in ordinary Tuesday conversations.
